message.content:
I've noticed some mild darkening of the skin over my finger joints and knees. I haven't had any fever, night sweats, or cough. As for the other things you listed, like tiredness, dizziness, weight loss, nausea or salt cravings, those weren't mentioned in what I was told, so I'm not sure about them.

About my history: I was in the hospital about five years ago because of a spot on my chest imaging, but I was never told I had TB and I never got treated for it. I haven't taken steroids, and nobody in my family has any inherited diseases that I know of. I'm not sure about other autoimmune conditions or what other medications I might take.
